levels.surface: محمد بن يوسف بن ثابت بن قيس بن شماس

notes: Editor glosses between dashes are left out. The dash-enclosed «وقال ابن صالح» names Muhammad b. Yusuf b. Thabit at the same level, so it is read as variant group 2.
«عن ثابت بن قيس ثم أخذ ترابا» opens a second saying with no chain of its own; flagged, not read as a route.
«وقال ابن السرح يوسف بن محمد وهو الصواب» is a compiler remark, not a link.
